root/code-structure-converse/code-induce.summary: Every deterministic finite-block private-message code induces variables satisfying the exact fixed-map factorization, four rate rows, and an absolute dependence-balance defect bounded by max(delta_1,delta_2). This is a sequence-level necessary condition, not by itself a fixed-cardinality single-letter outer region.
root/code-structure-converse/code-induce.title: Code-induced finite-block dependence balance

root/code-structure-converse/copy-extens.summary: Because the counterfeit is an actual finite distribution, every universally valid finite-variable information inequality holds at it. Standard finite copy-lemma extensions can be realized by conditional resampling while preserving the original marginal and objective, so they cannot remove the witness.
root/code-structure-converse/copy-extens.title: Finite copy-extension obstruction

root/code-structure-converse/entropy-cop.summary: For the specified coarse entropy relaxation, an entropic feasible point attains 2h_2(1/4)-5/4 on both direct branches. Consequently, universally valid finite-variable information inequalities and finite standard copy-lemma sequences cannot lower that relaxation below this value. The obstruction does not cover exact binary-posterior or other channel-specific consistency constraints.
root/code-structure-converse/entropy-cop.title: Entropy and copy-lemma refinement no-go

root/code-structure-converse/entropy-cou.summary: An explicit distribution built from independent binary components satisfies the stated coarse BSSC entropy vector, structural equalities, dependence balance, all specified conditional BEC identities, and both sharp support rows. Both direct sum branches equal 2h_2(1/4)-5/4.
root/code-structure-converse/entropy-cou.title: Explicit finite entropic counterfeit witness

root/code-structure-converse/exact-witne.summary: A standard-library symbolic checker represents every component entropy as an affine expression in h_2(1/4) and verifies component positivity, the base entropy vector, structural equalities, dependence balance, all 65 disjoint-subtuple BEC identities, both support rows, and both objective branches without floating-point arithmetic.
root/code-structure-converse/exact-witne.title: Exact affine entropy witness checker

root/code-structure-converse/finite-bloc.summary: The proof introduces S_i=(Y^{i-1},Z_{i+1}^n), telescopes the conditional message-dependence difference to the two block-output endpoints, and applies separate Fano bounds. Time sampling preserves message and time independence, the fixed encoder map, the memoryless law, and four compatible rate inequalities.
root/code-structure-converse/finite-bloc.title: Finite-block dependence-balance telescope

root/code-structure-converse.objective: Derive converse constraints from actual private-message codes and determine which single-letter or channel-specific refinements can strengthen BSSC sum-capacity bounds.
root/code-structure-converse.title: Code-induced converse structure

root/code-structure-converse/dependence-.summary: Develop code-induced dependence-balance converses, establish safe single-letter reductions, and investigate exact BSSC posterior constraints after the entropy-only and finite copy-lemma refinement route is obstructed.
root/code-structure-converse/dependence-.title: Dependence balance and channel-specific refinement
